card.fact_statement: A silent vigil was held outside Schöntal Park on 23 January.
card.source_span: On 23 January, a silent vigil attended by 3,000 people was held outside of Schöntal Park.

target_qa_variants.question: ¿En qué fecha se llevó a cabo una vigilia silenciosa a las afueras del parque Schöntal tras el apuñalamiento de Aschaffenburg de 2025?
target_qa_variants.source_span: On 23 January, a silent vigil attended by 3,000 people was held outside of Schöntal Park.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'stabbing attack' as 'apuñalamiento'. The alias 'January 23' was translated literally as 'enero 23', although '23 de enero' is the standard format in Spanish.
